description: This header file declares functions related to monitoring the health of a filesystem monitor daemon, including initialization, cleanup, running the health check loop, and asynchronous stopping, primarily for platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: fsm_health__ctor
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific data for the fsmonitor health thread.

methods.name: fsm_health__dtor
methods.description: Cleans up platform-specific data for the health thread.

methods.name: fsm_health__loop
methods.description: Runs the platform-specific event loop to monitor the health of the daemon process in the health thread.

methods.name: fsm_health__stop_async
methods.description: Requests the health thread to shutdown asynchronously.
